Quick Answer: What is Legrand Myrius NextGen Switch, 6A used for?

Legrand Myrius NextGen Switch, 6A is a compact 1-module electrical switch, designed for controlling lights and low-power appliances with 1-way or 2-way switching capability at 240V.

  • Current Rating: 6 Ampere
  • Voltage: 240V AC
  • Module Size: 1 Module (compact)
  • Switching Type: 1 Way or 2 Way
  • Brand: Legrand Myrius NextGen

Legrand Myrius NextGen Switch, 6A is a versatile modular switch perfect for residential and light commercial applications. Its compact 1-module design maximizes space efficiency while providing reliable switching control for lighting circuits and low-power appliances.

This switch supports both 1-way and 2-way configurations, offering flexibility in installation. Whether you need simple on/off control or multi-point switching for staircases and corridors, this switch delivers consistent performance with Legrand's renowned quality and durability.

Technical Specifications (Quick Reference)

Specification Details
Brand Legrand Myrius NextGen
Current Rating 6 Ampere
Voltage 240V AC
Module Size 1 Module
Switching Configuration 1 Way or 2 Way

Recommended Applications

  • Lighting Control: Perfect for controlling LED lights, CFLs, tube lights, and decorative lighting
  • Ceiling Fans: Suitable for on/off control of standard ceiling fans (use with separate regulator for speed control)
  • Staircase Lighting: Ideal for 2-way switching in staircases, corridors, and hallways
  • Bedroom Lighting: Control bedside lamps and room lights with convenient placement
  • Small Appliances: Switch control for low-power devices like exhaust fans and small heaters
  • Modular Installations: Combine with other Myrius NextGen modules for customized switch panels

Installation Guidelines

  1. Power Isolation: Turn off the main power supply and verify with a voltage tester before beginning work
  2. Wiring Connection: For 1-way: connect incoming live to L1 and outgoing to L2. For 2-way: use L1, L2, and common terminal as per wiring diagram
  3. Module Installation: Insert the switch module into the Myrius NextGen plate, ensuring it clicks securely into place
  4. Testing: Restore power and test the switch operation to ensure proper functionality before final use

1) What is the difference between 1-way and 2-way switching?

1-way switching allows you to control a light from one location only, while 2-way switching enables control from two different locations (like top and bottom of stairs). This switch supports both configurations.

2) Can I use this 6A switch for a ceiling fan?

Yes, you can use this switch for on/off control of ceiling fans. However, for speed control, you'll need a separate fan regulator. The 6A rating is sufficient for standard ceiling fans which typically draw 70-100W.

3) What is the maximum wattage this switch can handle?

At 240V, this 6A switch can safely handle up to 1440 watts (6A × 240V). This is suitable for multiple LED bulbs, CFLs, or a combination of lights on a single circuit.

4) Can I replace my old switch with this Myrius NextGen switch?

Yes, but you'll need the complete Myrius NextGen modular system including the plate and frame. This switch is part of a modular system and cannot be used standalone. Ensure your existing wall box is compatible with modular fittings.

5) What wire size should I use for installation?

For 6A circuits, use 1.5 sq mm copper wire (14 AWG). This is the standard wire size for lighting circuits in residential installations. Always follow local electrical codes.

6) Does this switch make a clicking sound when operated?

Yes, like most quality switches, the Myrius NextGen switch produces a subtle click sound when toggled, indicating positive contact and reliable switching action. This is a sign of quality construction.
